# Pricing

Simple, usage-based plans. Pay for the pages you fetch, not for seats.

[Start free](https://example.com/signup) · [Talk to sales](https://example.com/contact)

## Compare plans

| Plan | Starter | Growth | Enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Price per month | $29 | $99 | $499 |
| Credits per month | 10,000 | 100,000 | 1,000,000 |
| Concurrency | 5 | 20 | 100 |
| Support | Email | Priority email | Dedicated engineer |
| SLA | — | 99.5% | 99.9% |

## Starter

$29 per month. For side projects and prototypes: 10,000 credits, 5 concurrent requests, email support.

- 10,000 credits every month
- Community support
- Cancel any time

## Growth

$99 per month. For teams shipping to production: 100,000 credits, 20 concurrent requests, priority email support and a 99.5% uptime SLA.

## Enterprise

Enterprise is priced at $499 per month, billed annually, and includes a dedicated success engineer. Custom credit volumes, SSO and a signed DPA are available on request.

Contact sales for regional pricing and invoicing.

## Frequently asked questions

**What counts as a credit?** One credit is one page fetched by `scrape`. A `search_web` call is 5 credits.

**Can I change plans?** Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing date.

**Do unused credits roll over?** No. Credits reset on the first day of each billing period.

**Is there a free tier?** Every account starts with 1,000 credits, once, with no monthly refill.
